findings.draft_passage: Boston belonged to neither tide—hardly even to America.
findings.source_has: Every one now smiles at the bad taste of Queen Victoria and Louis Philippe—the society of the forties—but the taste was only a reflection of the social slack-water between a tide passed, and a tide to come. Boston belonged to neither, and hardly even to America.
findings.gate_test_answer: A reader is genuinely confused because “neither tide” presupposes two specific tides that the draft has cut; without the prior clause defining them, the contrast lacks its necessary setup.

findings.draft_passage: …and when things reached this condition, Lee had to exhaust his authority over his own staff.
findings.source_has: “…the two others who seemed instinctively to form a staff for Lee, were town‑Virginians from Petersburg.” … “and when things reached this condition, Lee had to exhaust his authority over his own staff.”
findings.gate_test_answer: A reader would be genuinely confused about what “his own staff” means, since the draft cut the earlier explanation that two fellow Virginians formed Lee’s ‘staff,’ leaving ‘staff’ to be mistaken for a military or undefined group.

findings.draft_passage: …when Mr. Apthorp gently protested—for of course he enjoyed Beethoven—Adams replied that he loathed Beethoven, and was surprised when they laughed as though they thought it humor.
findings.source_has: …when Mr. Apthorp gently protested that he exaggerated his indifference, for of course he enjoyed Beethoven, Adams replied simply that he loathed Beethoven; and felt a slight surprise when Mr. Apthorp and the others laughed as though they thought it humor.
findings.gate_test_answer: A reader can’t tell whether “he” refers to Apthorp or to Adams, which muddies why Apthorp’s protest makes sense and thus creates real referential confusion.

findings.draft_passage: Only starfish, shell-fish, polyps, or trilobites — whose kindly descendants he had often bathed with, as a child on the shores of Quincy Bay.
findings.source_has: No trace of any vertebrate had been found there; only starfish, shell-fish, polyps, or trilobites whose kindly descendants he had often bathed with, as a child on the shores of Quincy Bay.
findings.gate_test_answer: A reader would stumble because the sentence has no main clause, making it grammatically incomplete and momentarily confusing.

findings.draft_passage: Neither in the Limulus nor in the Terebratula, any more than in the Pteraspis, could one conceive an ancestor; but, if one must, the choice mattered little.
findings.source_has: …the fascinating creature he had called a horseshoe… In Siluria, he understood, Sir Roderick Murchison called the horseshoe a Limulus, which helped nothing.
findings.gate_test_answer: A reader is genuinely left unsure what “Limulus” refers to, since the draft omits the source’s gloss that it is the horseshoe crab.

findings.draft_passage: Only starfish, shell-fish, polyps, or trilobites — whose kindly descendants he had often bathed with, as a child on the shores of Quincy Bay.
findings.source_has: No trace of any vertebrate had been found there; only starfish, shell-fish, polyps, or trilobites whose kindly descendants he had often bathed with, as a child on the shores of Quincy Bay.
findings.gate_test_answer: A reader would stumble because the draft sentence lacks a main verb and reads as a fragment, obscuring that it modifies the preceding claim about what existed before Pteraspis.

findings.draft_passage: Lying on the turf, the ground littered with newspapers, the monks studied the war correspondence.
findings.source_has: Only the few remaining monks, undisturbed by the brutalities of Henry VIII—three or four young Englishmen—survived there, with Milnes Gaskell acting as Prior. … Lying on the turf the ground littered with newspapers, the monks studied the war correspondence.
findings.gate_test_answer: A reader is genuinely misled to think actual monastics are present at Wenlock Abbey, since the draft omits the source’s gloss that “the monks” are a few young Englishmen jokingly so called.

findings.draft_passage: The young men of the Fortieth Parallel had Californian instincts; they were brothers of Bret Harte.
findings.source_has: One of his friends from earliest childhood, and nearest neighbor in Quincy, Frank Emmons, had become a geologist and joined the Fortieth Parallel Survey under Government. ... Of course when Adams took the Review he put it at the service of the Survey... Emmons's party was out of reach in the Uintahs, but Arnold Hague's had come in to Laramie for supplies... King and the Fortieth Parallel influenced him in a way far more vital.
findings.gate_test_answer: A reader is genuinely confused about what “the Fortieth Parallel” refers to—without the source’s explicit identification of it as King’s Government Survey, it reads like a latitude or vague region rather than a specific survey team.

findings.draft_passage: Compelled once more to lean heavily on this support, Adams covered more thousands of pages with figures as formal as though they were algebra...
findings.source_has: In such labyrinths, the staff is a force almost more necessary than the legs; the pen becomes a sort of blind-man's dog, to keep him from falling into the gutters. The pen works for itself, and acts like a hand, modelling the plastic material over and over again to the form that suits it best. ... Compelled once more to lean heavily on this support, Adams covered more thousands of pages with figures as formal as though they were algebra...
findings.gate_test_answer: A reader is genuinely confused because 'this support' has no antecedent in the draft; the cut passage defining the pen as his 'support' is required for the sentence to make sense.

findings.draft_passage: As the monkey looked back across the Baltic from the safe battlements of Stockholm, Russia looked more portentous than from the Kremlin.
findings.source_has:
…the tourist who carried his La Fontaine in mind, caught himself talking as bear or as monkey according to the mirror he held before him. "Am I satisfied?" he asked:--

"Moi? pourquoi non?
N'ai-je pas quatre pieds aussi bien que les autres?
Mon portrait jusqu'ici ne m'a rien reproche;
Mais pour mon frere l'ours, on ne l'a qu'ebauche;
Jamais, s'il me veut croire, il ne se fera peindre."

…As the monkey looked back across the Baltic from the safe battlements of Stockholm, Russia looked more portentous than from the Kremlin.
findings.gate_test_answer: A reader lacks the La Fontaine setup that identifies who “the monkey” represents, so the metaphor appears without explanation and can confuse who is being called the monkey.

findings.draft_passage: In contrast, Stockholm seemed a southern vision, and Sweden lured the tourist on.
findings.source_has: In contrast with the dreary forests of Russia and the stern streets of St. Petersburg, Stockholm seemed a southern vision, and Sweden lured the tourist on.
findings.gate_test_answer: The connective “In contrast” lacks a stated counterpart in the draft, leaving readers to guess what Stockholm is contrasted with.

findings.draft_passage: As the monkey looked back across the Baltic from the safe battlements of Stockholm, Russia looked more portentous than from the Kremlin.
findings.source_has:
…the tourist who carried his La Fontaine in mind, caught himself talking as bear or as monkey according to the mirror he held before him. "Am I satisfied?" he asked:—
[La Fontaine verses]
…The monkey and motor were terribly afraid of the bear; … As the monkey looked back across the Baltic from the safe battlements of Stockholm, Russia looked more portentous than from the Kremlin.
findings.gate_test_answer: A reader would be genuinely confused about who “the monkey” is, since the draft drops the La Fontaine gloss that defines Adams’s self‑metaphor as the monkey contrasted with the bear.

findings.draft_passage: Hay's and McKinley's statesmanship turned on persuading the Kaiser to join what might be called the Coal-power combination, rather than build a Gun-power combination by merging Germany in Russia.
findings.source_has: …Hay's and McKinley's statesmanship turned on the point of persuading the Kaiser to join what might be called the Coal-power combination, rather than build up the only possible alternative, a Gun-power combination by merging Germany in Russia. … He had, at least, the mechanical assurance of certain values to guide him—like the relative intensities of his Coal-powers, and relative inertia of his Gun-powers…
findings.gate_test_answer: A reader is genuinely left unsure what “Coal-power” and “Gun-power” denote because the draft never defines them; the source later supplies a minimal gloss (relative intensity vs. inertia) that anchors the terms.

findings.draft_passage: This personal sympathy prolonged Hay's life, and led directly to a revolution in Germany.
findings.source_has: To Herbert and his wife, the small knot of houses that seemed to give a vague unity to foreign affairs opened their doors and their hearts, for the Herberts were already at home there; and this personal sympathy prolonged Hay's life, for it not only eased the effort of endurance, but it also led directly to a revolution in Germany.
findings.gate_test_answer: A reader is genuinely confused because the draft never establishes any specific 'personal sympathy' between Hay and the Herberts, so the demonstrative 'This personal sympathy' lacks an unambiguous antecedent in the draft.

findings.draft_passage: All it needed to know was the admission of ignorance. Radium happened to radiate something that seemed to explode the scientific magazine, bringing thought, for the time, to a standstill;
findings.source_has: History had no need to ask what either might be; all it needed to know was the admission of ignorance; the mere fact of multiplicity baffling science.
findings.gate_test_answer: A reader will stumble over what "it" refers to—nothing in the draft’s immediately preceding sentences names "history," so the pronoun lacks an unambiguous antecedent and creates real confusion.

findings.draft_passage: Forces grasped his wrists and flung him about as though he had hold of a live wire or a runaway automobile—
findings.source_has: Man could no longer hold it off. Forces grasped his wrists and flung him about as though he had hold of a live wire or a runaway automobile; which was very nearly the exact truth for the purposes of an elderly and timid single gentleman in Paris...
findings.gate_test_answer: A reader is genuinely confused because the draft introduces 'his' with no prior referent in the paragraph, leaving it unclear whose wrists are being grasped until a later aside, whereas the source first establishes 'Man' as the antecedent.

findings.draft_passage: Emmons's party was out of reach in the Uintahs, but Arnold Hague's had come in to Laramie for supplies, and they took charge of Adams for a time.
findings.source_has: One of his friends from earliest childhood, and nearest neighbor in Quincy, Frank Emmons, had become a geologist and joined the Fortieth Parallel Survey under Government. At Washington in the winter of 1869-70, Emmons had invited Adams to go out with him on one of the field-parties in summer... Emmons's party was out of reach in the Uintahs, but Arnold Hague's had come in to Laramie for supplies.
findings.gate_test_answer: A reader is genuinely confused: 'Emmons' is a proper name that appears nowhere earlier in the draft, so 'Emmons's party' has no established referent and the reader cannot identify who Emmons is or why his party's whereabouts are relevant.

findings.draft_passage: What roused in Adams's mind more rebellion was the patience and good-nature with which Hay allowed himself to be used.
findings.source_has: Adams's opinion of politics and politicians, as he frankly admitted, lacked enthusiasm...and he explained everything by his old explanation of Grant's character as more or less a general type; but what roused in his mind more rebellion was the patience and good-nature with which Hay allowed himself to be used.
findings.gate_test_answer: A reader is genuinely confused: 'more rebellion' is a comparative that requires a stated baseline of lesser rebellion, but the draft cuts the preceding sentence establishing Adams's baseline irritation with politicians generally (the Grant explanation), leaving 'more' dangling against nothing and making the sentence logically incomplete.
